title: Mrs. Michal Tawil: Mother/ Daughter - Navigating an Illness With an Eye on God (Class # 33)

chapters.title: Introduction and family situation
chapters.about: The teacher shares the news of her granddaughter's illness and her role as a grandmother.

chapters.title: The medical journey
chapters.about: Details regarding the baby's failure to thrive, diagnosis, and hospital care.

chapters.title: The avodah of choosing
chapters.about: Discussing the spiritual work of making choices and staying present with Hashem.

chapters.title: Living with Hashem's hand
chapters.about: The concept of being a choosing woman and relinquishing the feeling of loss.

chapters.title: The teacher's personal avodah
chapters.about: Reflecting on the need to show Hashem rather than oneself in professional and personal tasks.

summary: Mrs. Tawil shares her personal experience and the spiritual work she and her daughter Malka are undertaking while navigating the illness of her granddaughter, Michal Levona. She discusses the importance of being fully present with Hashem in every choice one makes, rather than feeling torn between competing responsibilities. The class encourages listeners to adopt this approach and to dedicate their own spiritual efforts toward the healing of Michal Levona.
questions: How can I stop feeling guilty when I choose one responsibility over another?
How do I stay present with Hashem when I am overwhelmed by daily tasks?
Is it possible to be a dedicated mother and still pursue my own interests?
How should I handle the 'why' questions when facing a difficult situation?
How can my personal spiritual growth impact the health of a loved one?
